description: PAL/3 Draft 0.6 decision vectors for section 11.3 item 2 (enrollment and migration) and 11.2 item 2 (caller binding). Written from the specification text; no reference implementation exists in pal-core.

enrollment.name: selfCertifiedEnrollsOnFirstLoad
enrollment.description: A self-certified device with the identity secret key enrolls itself on first load

enrollment.name: noIdentitySecretKeyCannotSelfEnroll
enrollment.description: A device that holds only device keys cannot issue its own delegated certificate; it waits for one issued at pairing

enrollment.name: delegatedBeforeExpiryRenewsWithSameDeviceId
enrollment.description: A delegated certificate is renewed before expires_at_ms with the same device_id

enrollment.name: delegatedFarFromExpiryIsLeftAlone
enrollment.description: Outside the renewal window nothing is done

enrollment.name: delegatedWithoutSecretKeyCannotRenewItself
enrollment.description: Renewal needs the identity secret key on the device

enrollment.name: deviceIdMustNotBeDerivedFromTheIdentityKey
enrollment.description: A device_id that equals the identity-derived value of the self-certified form is not acceptable for a delegated certificate

receiverForms.name: delegatedAcceptedWithoutStatement
receiverForms.description: A receiver with no statement accepts the delegated form

receiverForms.name: selfCertifiedAcceptedWithoutStatement
receiverForms.description: A receiver with no statement still accepts the self-certified form (migration)

receiverForms.name: delegatedAcceptedWithStatement
receiverForms.description: With a statement held, a delegated certificate whose device_id is not revoked is accepted

receiverForms.name: selfCertifiedRefusedOnceAStatementIsHeld
receiverForms.description: Once any statement is held the self-certified form is refused: its device_id cannot be revoked separately

callerBinding.name: claimMatchesVerifiedCertificate
callerBinding.description: The identity a request acts as equals the identity of the verified certificate

callerBinding.name: claimForAnotherIdentityIsRefused
callerBinding.description: A request that names another identity than the verified certificate is refused

callerBinding.name: noVerifiedCertificateIsRefused
callerBinding.description: Without a handshake-verified certificate no identity can be bound

callerBinding.name: missingClaimActsAsTheCertificateIdentity
callerBinding.description: An operation that names no identity acts as the certificate identity
